races.name: Chester Roman Day Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Lucky Luna
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely strong pace, shaped well on debut and quick return suggests confidence from Hannon stable
runners_data.comment: 40,000gns yearling; three winning siblings; bred for further but worth a market check
runners_data.spotlight: 6-1, shaped well when a debut fourth of 12 in maiden at Salisbury (6f, good) a week ago; this Lucky Vega filly can take a step forward now, especially over this longer trip; very much one to consider.

runners_data.name: Town Queen
runners_data.note: Natural leader with proven 7f form, Burke's 3/43 record concerning but filly has clear class edge
runners_data.spotlight: Blue Point filly who has shaped well when runner-up in 6f Pontefract novice and 7f Thirsk maiden this spring, leading for a long way on latter occasion four weeks ago; she's open to further progress and rates a big player.

runners_data.name: Machadadorp
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who faded at Ascot but Murphy booking significant, needs to build on debut effort
runners_data.comment: Bred to have a future but she'd need to be decidedly useful to take this on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 20-1, faded late on when sixth of seven in novice at Ascot (1m, good to firm) on her debut last month; this daughter of Mehmas can build on it here for her leading yard.

runners_data.name: Navona Grey
runners_data.note: Completely unknown quantity for Kelleway who has 0/4 record in last 14 days, breeding suggests middle distances
runners_data.spotlight: 25,000 guineas yearling, 22,000 euros 2yo; half-sister to bumper and 1m3f AW winner Galaxy Star (RPR 90); dam, 11.6f-2m winner (RPR 75), is a half-sister to Australian 1m1f Listed winner Greatwood, out of close relative of Gold Cup winner Fame And Glory; the market can guide for this Havana Grey filly.

runners_data.name: Night Shining
runners_data.note: Improved markedly second time out, hold-up style will suit if pace is strong as expected
runners_data.spotlight: Took a big step forward from her debut when fourth of six in 7f Yarmouth novice last month; this daughter of Dark Angel can do better still so enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Imelda
runners_data.note: Front-runner who may get outpaced by classier rivals, all-weather form needs translating to turf
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form shown when placed in a pair of 7f Wolverhampton maidens this spring, third of 11 on latter occasion; this Invincible Spirit filly may do better still but has a wide draw.

runners_data.name: Danrana
runners_data.note: Long absence of 279 days major concern despite early promise, needs to hit ground running
runners_data.spotlight: Dandy Man filly who failed to build on her debut fourth when only eighth of 13 in 7.5f maiden at Beverley in August; needs to hit the ground running on her return.

runners_data.name: Elemma
runners_data.note: Stepped up at Ripon but more required, prominent style could suit if pace is steady
runners_data.comment: Well-beaten last of four on debut at Pontefract (6f, good); big leap forward required
runners_data.spotlight: Daughter of Starman; stepped up on her debut when fifth of eight in 6f Ripon novice 13 days ago; handily drawn but more is required here.

runners_data.name: Tommie's Angel
runners_data.note: Poor form in weak maidens, apprentice jockey suggests connections not confident
runners_data.comment: Ran to a modest level on her Southwell debut (6f) two weeks ago; longer-term prospect
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form shown in a pair of 6f maidens at Southwell and Pontefract this spring; lots more is required.

runners_data.name: Lc Tiffen
runners_data.note: Weak form throughout career, apprentice claim needed just to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Well beaten at huge odds in thee turf novices races (6f-7.3f) last summer; not seen since
runners_data.spotlight: Only poor form shown thus far, beating one on her first go in handicaps at Wolverhampton (7f) last month.

runners_data.name: Golden Mabel
runners_data.note: Yet to show any ability in four starts, front-running style could see her outpaced early
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to offer much in her four runs to date, last of seven on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.5f) 12 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Town Queen, Imelda, and Golden Mabel will ensure a strong early gallop with all three having confirmed leading tendencies over this 7f trip. Town Queen has led for a long way in recent outings while Imelda has shown early pace in her placed efforts at Wolverhampton. This sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the closing stages. Hold-up horses like Lucky Luna, Machadadorp, and Night Shining will benefit most as the pace-setters tire, with the race strongly favouring those who can finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and weaken markedly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch stamina and allow closers to pick up the pieces as front-runners fade. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed will have ideal conditions to strike late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Town Queen Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Town Queen can control the pace and kick clear of her rivals
scenarios.body: Her proven ability to lead for long periods gives her the edge if she can dictate terms and see off challenges. The Burke filly has the class edge with two runner-up efforts already.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Moderate Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders settle into a steady rhythm without over-exerting early
scenarios.body: Prominent runners who can track the pace will be perfectly positioned for a sustained drive. Those sitting just behind the leaders can time their challenges effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Imelda Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Imelda can steal a march and maintain her advantage throughout
scenarios.body: The Loughnane filly has shown early pace on the all-weather and could surprise if allowed an easy lead. Her placed form gives her an outside chance if everything falls right.

watchPoints.text: Town Queen could dictate if other leaders don't engage early, making her very dangerous
Navona Grey is completely unexposed for connections with poor recent strike-rate
Danrana returning after 279-day break with fitness questions despite early promise
Lucky Luna shaped promisingly on debut and quick reappearance suggests trainer confidence
Night Shining improved significantly second time out and hold-up style suits likely pace scenario

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Pure Grit
runners_data.spotlight: 230,000euros yearling by Pinatubo; 8-1, made most when second of ten in Newbury maiden (6f, good) 15 days ago; lots to like if he adapts to this track.

runners_data.name: Deputy Vice
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000euros foal, 90,000gns yearling, £145,000 breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; Mehmas half-brother to winners Habrdi (6f-1m including 2yo; RPR 92) and Inside Story (6f 2yo; 80); dam once-raced (43) sister to useful 1m/9.4f winner Turnberry Isle, out of Cheveley Park winner Rosdhu Queen; trainer has had two 2yos run this season and one is 3-3, including a Lily Agnes win at this track.

runners_data.name: Dream On Kent
runners_data.spotlight: By Massaat; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Amber Blossom (7f AW 2yo/7.4f turf; RPR 72) and Not A Sinner (US 6f turf): dam 6f winner (including 2yo/AW; 105), half-sister to Italian 1m1f 2yo Group 3 winner; late foal but with trainer whose latest 2yos have already made their mark.

runners_data.name: Virtuous Star
runners_data.spotlight: 240,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Starman; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Majestic Myles (7f Listed), Parbold (Group-placed 6f 2yo) and Majestic Moon (useful 6f/7f); stable won this with a newcomer two years ago and this is one to note.

runners_data.name: Trust Havana
runners_data.spotlight: 85,000euros foal, £17,000 breeze-up 2yo by Havana Grey; first foal; dam placed in Slovakia, half-sister to winners Preferential (1m4f Listed) and Rule Of Nature (6f 2yo), out of maiden half-sister to 7f Group 1 winner Etoile Montante; trainer is better known for jumpers but had a 2yo winner here (her fourth race) last term.

runners_data.name: Blake's Monarch
runners_data.spotlight: 10-1, short-headed in 11-runner novice at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) 19 days ago, leading until final strides; while that was a promising debut and he seemingly has the pace for another bold show from low draw here, others probably bring better form.

runners_data.name: Metamouse
runners_data.comment: 8,000euros March foal, 18,000euros yearling; watch for market confidence on his debut
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 for maiden at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) nine days ago when an always-prominent fourth of 12; should improve but has a wide draw and probably some tough company.

runners_data.name: This Moment
runners_data.comment: Showcasing colt; appeals on paper and must enter calculations for powerful stable
runners_data.spotlight: Late foal, with useful pedigree for this sort of test; second favourite for six-runner novice at Hamilton (6f, good) 13 days ago but slowly away and a detached last to past halfway, before challenging hard from over 1f out and beaten a head; that's probably among the best form in this and he could be a lot wiser this time.

runners_data.name: Star People
runners_data.spotlight: Faded to finish towards rear in novice at York (6f, good) 16 days ago but was 8-1, so much better was presumably expected of him.

runners_data.name: Caturra Lights
runners_data.comment: Sets the standard, assuming the form of his 66-1 third at Musselburgh is backed up
runners_data.spotlight: Close third in maidens at Musselburgh (5f, good) and Chester (5.5f, good) are both among the best form in this field; a leading contender.

runners_data.name: Moriarty Moon
runners_data.spotlight: Has a pretty useful pedigree but last of six in novice at Goodwood (5f, good; 14-1) four weeks ago was a low-key debut.

runners_data.name: Koodini
runners_data.spotlight: Suitably bred and nicely drawn for 5.5f maiden here (good) three weeks ago but rather slowly away and hampered twice in the closing stages when he'd got in touch; weak 13-2 that day, while two stablemates (9-4 and 10-1) finished first and second; capable of better but this time has a wide draw.

races.name: Kingkabs Selling Stakes

runners_data.name: Delete Delete
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with strong breeding connections but completely unknown quantity making debut assessment difficult.
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; by Massaat; sixth foal; brother to winners Mas Rapido (6f including 2yo/US; RPR 106), Rapido Girl (7f; 74) and Priestess (6f/7f 2yo including AW/Italy; 60); dam placed 5f (including 2yo/AW; 61), half-sister to 5.7f 2yo winner/UAE Oaks runner-up Mary Fildes; stable have had a couple of 2yo newcomers go close; betting to guide.

runners_data.name: Stellar Quest
runners_data.note: Another debutant from powerful Burke yard but lacks any form reference for this competitive heat.
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000euros foal; by Space Traveller; third foal; half-brother to winners Solvency (5f 2yo including AW; RPR 83) and Latin Race (Italian 5f 2yo/6f); dam twice-raced (at 5f; 69) half-sister to Qatari 6f-1m winner Mister Staple; represents a top yard and he is one to take seriously starting out in selling company.

runners_data.name: Shaniko
runners_data.note: Debut runner wearing hood suggests needs encouragement and best watched for future reference rather than backed.
runners_data.spotlight: By Hello Youmzain; first foal of an unraced dam, herself closely related to French 1m4f winner Imperious Man; hooded for debut; best watched.

runners_data.name: Trust In Far
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but showed alarming tendency to fade badly when tailed off at Haydock just eight days ago.
runners_data.comment: £15,000 2yo breeze-ups; half-sister to seven winners but she may be best watched on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and tailed off in a 6f fillies' maiden at Haydock eight days ago (80-1); no appeal.

runners_data.name: Undercover Affair
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with course form advantage and clear RPR edge over most of these rivals.
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in all three starts, including here, and he ranks highly in calculations judged on RPRs; 6f should be fine but slower than good would be a first and stall 10 tempers enthusiasm too.

runners_data.name: Fortunate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form trend and difficult ride characteristics make her hard to recommend.
runners_data.comment: Failed to build on debut Wolverhampton sixth when last of 13 in 5f Bath novice last month
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in her three starts, looking a difficult ride at Kempton ten days ago; hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Claret And Blues
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping up in trip from 5f which should suit but drawn widest in stall 12.
runners_data.spotlight: He has shown some promise in two 5f novice runs (good ground/Tapeta) and this drop in grade/step up in trip can help; stall 12 no assistance though.

runners_data.name: Happy Humpo
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but hasn't run for 45 days and showed little ability when tailed off at Beverley.
runners_data.spotlight: 12-1 and always in rear when last of 11 at Beverley last month (5f, good to soft); should do better in time and interesting to see how she fares in the market now dropped into a seller; well drawn.

runners_data.name: Explainingislosing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with improving form trend but needs to find significant improvement to trouble the principals.
runners_data.comment: Green when unable to land telling blow at Beverley on debut; should fare better this time
runners_data.spotlight: Signs of ability in two 5f maidens this month, latterly a third of seven at Musselburgh nine days ago; 6f will suit but he has over 4l to make up with Furturra on his latest effort and he is drawn out in stall 11.

runners_data.name: Furturra
runners_data.note: Prominent racer untried at 6f but clear second-best on RPR ratings behind highly-regarded stablemate recently.
runners_data.spotlight: Untried at 6f but he has displayed clear promise at shorter trips, finishing a clear second behind a stablemate at Musselburgh nine days ago (5f, good to soft); fared okay with the draw and Oisin Murphy is booked; chance.

runners_data.name: Everatease
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with progressive profile suggesting the step up to 6f will unlock further improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: He has improved his RPR with each of his three runs in 5f maidens and the last two times he has looked as though this longer trip would suit; slower ground to contend with but more appealing than many.

runners_data.name: Stay On Tab
runners_data.note: Prominent early but poor overall form level and new tongue-tie suggests more hope than substance.
runners_data.comment: Modest form in two C&D runs last month; nurseries should prove more suitable in time
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in three 5f runs, the latest behind two reopposing rivals at Musselburgh nine days ago; new trip/tongue-tie not enough to tempt.

races.paceDynamic: Undercover Affair will take this field along from the front without serious pressure, with only Claret And Blues, Furturra and Stay On Tab likely to race prominently early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Undercover Affair can dictate terms and control fractions through the opening furlongs. Behind the leaders, a large group of hold-up horses including Explainingislosing, Everatease, Happy Humpo, Fortunate and Trust In Far will need to mount late challenges. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours front-running and prominent racing styles, as they can position close to a manageable gallop and have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Undercover Affair Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Undercover Affair leads uncontested and maintains a steady gallop.
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back when controlling the tempo from the outset. His proven form at this course and distance gives him every advantage in a race lacking serious pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Claret And Blues or Furturra press Undercover Affair for the early lead.
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up the race for closers who can benefit from stronger gallop and tactical positioning. Hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with genuine pace to aim at in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian with no pressure on Undercover Affair.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with natural speed have the edge over pure stayers. Those closest to the pace when the sprint begins will have decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three debutants shows significant improvement or natural ability.
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced horses benefit from unknown quantities and potential improvement curves. Their fresh legs and lack of exposed form could catch the exposed runners off guard.

watchPoints.text: Trust In Far was tailed off badly last time and represents a non-runner if repeating that effort.
Undercover Affair must handle any early pressure from prominent racers without getting into a speed duel.
Claret And Blues faces significant draw disadvantage from stall 12 in a field where early position matters.
The three debutants Delete Delete, Stellar Quest and Shaniko could spring surprises with unknown ability levels.
Everatease has improved with each run and the 6f trip extension may unlock his best performance yet.

races.name: Louise Keegan Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Midnight Rumble
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who stays well but has been struggling to win, though competitive handicapping suggests he's well-placed here
runners_data.comment: Sole win at 1m2f on AW in 2024; running well but little to suggest he's well treated
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win (22 races) was on AW in June 2024; five seconds on turf and bang there on AW (1m3f/1m4f) on last two starts before 30,000gns sale (left Alan King) in April, but this is the first time he's gone beyond that on Flat.

runners_data.name: Venezuelan
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner returning after 236 days off, but has solid form at this level when fresh and loves to lead
runners_data.comment: Left R Beckett 90,000gns October; just a maiden win but staying trips are worth exploring
runners_data.spotlight: Small-field Lingfield maiden last August was his only win but he was on the premises in nearly all his handicaps; tried various headgear on last five starts and switches it again on this first run since leaving Ralph Beckett for 90,000gns in October; unraced beyond 1m4f but staying trips are worth exploring and he has a competitive mark.

runners_data.name: Heathen
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with poor turf record but has shown form at Chester before over similar distances
runners_data.spotlight: 5-19 on AW and 0-9 on turf; twice close up over 1m4f on turf last year, including off this mark at Chester, but is also a dual 1m6f winner on AW and has at least one piece of 2m form in that sphere; a case can be made if he's tuned up sufficiently after 259 days off; the market may guide.

runners_data.name: Imperial Sovereign
runners_data.note: Patient type who ran well in the Chester Plate last time despite wide draw, handles the track
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win (19 races) was a novice in 2023; running respectably this term, drawn wide when never able to challenge in the Chester Plate last time; competitively handicapped but probably not the percentage call.

runners_data.name: Solar Pass
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up horse with Oisin Murphy aboard, though both wins came on AW and Chester form is poor
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have been on AW (latest in March) and her only run at this track did not go well, when favourite over 1m6f on heavy on final start last term; close second with first-time cheekpieces at Goodwood (2m, good) on latest outing, however, is a notable positive.

runners_data.name: Percy Jones
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer with excellent AW record but winless on turf in 22 attempts
runners_data.comment: 0-21 record on turf contains six 2nds, one of them behind Amancio in this race last year
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins were on Wolverhampton AW, the latest off a 2lb higher mark last August (1m4f); 0-22 record on turf includes six seconds and two of those (one last year) were at this track; this is his first 2m race for a while but he used to look fully effective over it and, with a run under his belt now this term, he's considered each-way in the first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Believitanducan
runners_data.note: Fresh winner at Ascot three weeks ago over 2m, prominent style suits but lacks Chester experience
runners_data.spotlight: Three months off before returning to Flat with a win at Ascot (2m, good; 12 ran) three weeks ago, always prominent as 11-8 favourite; up 4lb and lacks any experience of this track but a huge player if he takes to it.

runners_data.name: Savrola
runners_data.note: Progressive front-runner from last year but hasn't been seen since July and was well beaten on comeback
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive front-runner last year (over 1m6f, 1m5f and 2m) who finished either first or second in all five of those races, but he wasn't seen after July; 30l defeat on recent reappearance (12-1) suggests he's best watched but his trainer had two jumps winners this week.

runners_data.name: Ouro Preto
runners_data.note: French import with decent form but was disappointing when tried over shorter last time
runners_data.comment: Ex-French; well-beaten last of seven at Hamilton (1m3f, good; 14-1) eight days ago
runners_data.spotlight: 3-15 when trained in France, the latest win in a claimer at Longchamp (1m4f, very soft) last September; well handicapped judged on peak French efforts but he was a well-beaten last of seven on British debut at Hamilton (1m3f, good; 14-1) 15 days ago; unraced much beyond 1m4f.

runners_data.name: Kuredu King
runners_data.note: Former Gosden inmate returning from hurdles with wind surgery, best form was over these distances
runners_data.comment: Dual Flat winner; never involved on hurdles debut; since had wind surgery; more needed.
runners_data.spotlight: 11.6f and 1m6f handicap winner last year for the Gosdens; however, soundly beaten on both attempts over hurdles for new yard this spring, given wind surgery in between; player if he can tap back into those 2025 performances.

runners_data.name: Dance Time
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with poor turf record and none of her form matches this handicap mark
runners_data.comment: Second on heavy ground here in September but has done all her winning on AW
runners_data.spotlight: 6-19 on AW but 0-10 on turf; none of her turf form matches this mark and her second here last September was on heavy going; blinkered latest; while moving back up from 1m4f should help, others have more pressing claims.

races.paceDynamic: Venezuelan and Savrola will ensure a genuine gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this 2m trip at Chester's unique circuit. The honest pace they set will stretch the field and create pressure points, particularly around Chester's tight bends where positioning becomes crucial. This setup will test stamina reserves in the final 3f and should favor hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early pace will take its toll on the leaders. The race shape strongly favors patient, hold-up performers who can navigate Chester's quirks and deliver late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Venezuelan and Savrola maintain a strong gallop through halfway
scenarios.body: The honest pace stretches the field and creates gaps for closers to exploit in the final 2f. Patient riders can pick off tired leaders around Chester's testing bends.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can track the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: A horse like Midnight Rumble or Ouro Preto can position perfectly behind the leaders and strike when they weaken. The tactical advantage of avoiding the early battle proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If either Venezuelan or Savrola can dictate without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows one leader to control fractions and maintain enough in reserve for the finish. Chester's configuration can favor bold front-running when unopposed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners are restrained or encounter traffic problems early
scenarios.body: A slow-run race becomes a sprint finish where class and tactical speed matter most. The best-handicapped horses can overcome poor positioning.

watchPoints.text: Venezuelan and Savrola must both show early intent to create the expected honest pace - if either is restrained the race dynamics change completely
Believitanducan lacks any Chester experience despite his recent Ascot win and the unique track could catch him out
Imperial Sovereign ran well in the Chester Plate despite a wide draw so has proven course form at this level
Kuredu King is making his first start in 254 days and returning from hurdles with wind surgery
Solar Pass has poor Chester form and both career wins came on all-weather surfaces

races.name: Virgin Bet Handicap

runners_data.name: Supido
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven Chester form, 24-day break ideal, benefits from expected strong pace
runners_data.spotlight: Finished close up in fifth in the Britannia Stakes at Royal Ascot last year (1m, good to firm); his 3yo campaign rather fizzled out but he dropped in the weights as a result and took full advantage with his 7.6f success here 24 days ago; well drawn again and a 4lb rise isn't beyond him.

runners_data.name: Korker
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but fading form and seven-year-old legs may struggle with pace pressure
runners_data.spotlight: Slow-starter; on a dangerous mark but he is without a win since October 2023 and one 7f run didn't see him improve for the trip.

runners_data.name: Palmar Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-suited to Chester, consistent recent form but big weight burden
runners_data.spotlight: Ready winner of a C&D handicap last summer off a 12lb lower mark; better than ever when a close fourth in a Wolverhampton Listed race in March and he faced a stiff task at Haydock three weeks ago; should give his running but could find one or two stronger back in handicap company.

runners_data.name: Roman Dragon
runners_data.note: Excellent course record but rarely seen at 7f now, may prove vulnerable to stronger stayers
runners_data.spotlight: Enhanced his excellent course record when narrowly landing a 5f handicap at the May meeting; stays 7f but rarely seen at the trip now; may prove vulnerable to stronger stayers.

runners_data.name: The Angel King
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse showing promise for Ian Williams, 5lb claimer Ryan Kavanagh booked
runners_data.comment: Useful dual 7f winner in France but no obvious promise on recent yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French; low-key stable debut at Haydock in April but he fared much better when sixth, beaten under 3l, behind stablemate Supido here (7.6f, good) 24 days ago; he hasn't fared so kindly with the draw this time.

runners_data.name: Angel Hunter
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner needing career best, moderate recent form counts against
runners_data.spotlight: Narrow winner of a competitive 1m handicap at Lingfield on Good Friday; two midfield finishes this month and he will need a career best to come out on top in this field.

runners_data.name: Bobby Bennu
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but wide draw and 224-day layoff major concerns at Chester
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner; only eighth in the corresponding race 12 months ago; 4lb lower today but he is drawn wide and this may not be his day.

runners_data.name: Miami Matrix
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with two course wins, respectable stable debut for new trainer Patrick Morris
runners_data.spotlight: Two course wins (7.6f) for Hugo Palmer last summer; respectable fourth on this month's stable debut; should give his running but perhaps vulnerable for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Nizam
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but 80-1 stable debut suggests Ian Williams has stronger chances elsewhere
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins and boasted some strong form when trained in France; 80-1 and never threatened on his stable debut six weeks ago; Ian Williams looks to have stronger claims elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Brighton Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course form, 3lb claimer Warren Fentiman helps his cause
runners_data.comment: Poorly drawn when down the field at Chester last time; falling in weights; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner (7.6f, soft) for Andrew Balding last summer; not beaten far in the 7.6f handicap won by Supido 24 days ago (poor draw) and confirmed that promise with a Class 3 win at Thirsk a fortnight ago (7f, good); a 3lb rise shouldn't prove beyond him and Warren Fentiman's claim is a bonus.

runners_data.name: Elements Of Fire
runners_data.note: Front-runner with attacking draw advantage but needs career best on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner; 4-4 on AW but unplaced in both turf runs; he will need a career best to come out on top but he is well drawn to attack and still has low mileage.

runners_data.name: Midnight Strike
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better drawn today after poor position on stable debut
runners_data.comment: Ex-Irish 4yo who is 0-11 since debut win; makes stable/seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Useful 2yo for Joseph O'Brien; poorly drawn and finished well beaten in a C&D handicap on stable debut this month (100-1); he has fared better with the draw today but others still look more appealing.

runners_data.name: Lexington Jet
runners_data.note: Front-runner transformed by blinkers but needs significant step up in grade
runners_data.spotlight: Transformed by blinkers this year, making all in three 1m handicaps at Chelmsford; well drawn to attack but he will need a big personal best to score at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Elements Of Fire and Lexington Jet will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over Chester's unique circuit. Elements Of Fire has attacking draw advantage while Lexington Jet brings excellent course form, creating an honest tempo that should suit those able to travel just behind the pace. The combination of two willing leaders on Chester's tight track will set up a searching test, with the pace likely to collapse in the final furlong as stamina becomes paramount. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those racing prominently who can quicken late, as the early pace battle will leave front-runners vulnerable to swooping finishers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire and Lexington Jet engage in a sustained pace duel through the opening half-mile
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out both leaders in the final furlong, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired pace-setters. Late-running types like Supido and Roman Dragon can capitalise on superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Running Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters manages to steal a crucial margin while the other fades early
scenarios.body: A smart tactical ride from either Elements Of Fire or Lexington Jet could see them build an unassailable lead on the turn for home. The winner would need to have enough left to resist late challenges from hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves moderate with both leaders going too slowly to hurt each other
scenarios.body: Horses racing in prominent positions like Palmar Bay and Brighton Boy can position perfectly to strike in the straight. These runners get the best of both worlds - avoiding pace pressure while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems or interference at Chester's tight bends create gaps for improving horses
scenarios.body: The unique nature of Chester's track could see runners like Miami Matrix or Midnight Strike benefit from cleaner passages while fancied horses get caught in trouble. Fresh horses with recent course form often thrive in these circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Elements Of Fire and Lexington Jet must be watched for early pace-setting tactics as both will want to lead
Roman Dragon's early position critical given his preference for shorter trips now but course expertise
Supido and The Angel King represent Ian Williams who has strong course record and both need pace collapse
Traffic problems likely at Chester's tight bends with 13 runners, particularly affecting wide-drawn Bobby Bennu
Korker's finishing effort given recent fading tendencies and whether seven-year-old legs can respond

races.name: John Smith's Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Ruby's Angel
runners_data.note: Front-runner with Oisin Murphy aboard, thrives on good ground and has excellent course form
runners_data.comment: Won competitive nursery at the York Ebor festival in last turf attempt; likely player
runners_data.spotlight: Won a big-field nursery (6f, good to firm) at last season's Ebor meeting; good second to Cherry Baker over C&D on her seasonal reappearance and 4lb better off with that rival today; drawn in stall 1 on that occasion but she's widest today which makes it easy enough to look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Tarot
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 232 days off, bred to improve and suits strong pace scenarios
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in her first three 2yo starts; made all to win a 6f fillies' novice at Kempton when last seen in October; bred to carry on progressing and the second and third from that Kempton race won their next start; stall 11 makes life tough though.

runners_data.name: Champonie
runners_data.note: Hold-up type moving to handicaps, recent course experience gives her tactical advantage
runners_data.spotlight: Won 6f AW events on her first two starts; lost her unbeaten record but enhanced her reputation when keeping on for sixth in a 5f handicap here (good ground) three weeks ago; the return to this trip will suit and she remains capable of better.

runners_data.name: Hayynah
runners_data.note: Front-runner who needs to settle better, headgear change suggests connections seeking improvement
runners_data.comment: Went close in C&D novice in July; disappointed when last on h'cap debut (5f, AW) latest
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when beating eight rivals in a 5f novice at Southwell in February; had earlier chased home Champonie at Newcastle but had an experience advantage that day; needs to bounce back from a low-key Southwell run (5f; handicap debut) seven weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Evie Ross
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with blinkers fitted, recent poor run can be forgiven on quick return
runners_data.comment: Something to prove on the trip front but market support should be noted
runners_data.spotlight: Easily won a 5f maiden at Chepstow on her second 2yo run; never in the hunt behind Cherry Baker on her seasonal/handicap debut here 24 days ago but the run wasn't without hope, drawn wide in stall 12, racing freely under restraint and not enjoying a clear passage at a crucial time; stall 9 again not ideal but she's one to keep an eye on as the season progresses.

runners_data.name: Zighy
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner from George Boughey, comes here in good heart after recent win
runners_data.comment: Steady progress on AW; strength at finish last time makes this 7f an appealing option
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt as a 2yo, winning a 6f fillies' novice decisively; stronger form when coming from off the pace to win a Class 4 handicap at Southwell last month but she was beaten fair and square at Yarmouth two weeks later (7f, good to firm); return to 6f can help but Champonie may prove the yard's main hope.

runners_data.name: Cherry Baker
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with Cieren Fallon, excellent recent course win gives confidence boost
runners_data.spotlight: Found the Group 3 Nell Gwyn Stakes all too much for her on her reappearance but she left it behind on her handicap debut, enjoying a charmed run up the inside to score comfortably in a C&D handicap 24 days ago; up 5lb and drawn even wider today; another career best is required.

runners_data.name: Slay Queen
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from break, needs to bounce back from disappointing last run
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 6f last summer; low-key return to action at Newmarket four weeks ago (6f, good to firm; handles much slower); still 5lb higher than for her handicap win; vulnerable.

runners_data.name: Rogue Temptation
runners_data.comment: Reappearance fifth wasn't a bad effort three weeks ago; needs to build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well for third on her nursery debut at Doncaster (6.5f, good to soft) last September and she turns up here off a 7lb lower mark; that is a consequence of some disappointing runs since, including both her outings in 2026.

runners_data.name: Trust Amy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with quick turnaround after Listed run, Gary Hanmer stable in poor form
runners_data.comment: Came up short in Listed race and two nurseries towards end of last season; hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: C&D win last September before a good fifth in Listed company at Doncaster (6f, heavy); didn't run badly in another Listed event on last week's reappearance but her handicap runs don't suggest she is the answer, even from the inside stall.

runners_data.name: Saffron Dandy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose recent turf form is modest compared to all-weather efforts
runners_data.comment: Began 2026 with two AW wins; unplaced but not disgraced twice since; can't rule out
runners_data.spotlight: Of interest on this year's AW best; latest Ripon run was underwhelming though and others look open to greater progress.

runners_data.name: Fizzy Cristal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 3lb claimer, stepping up significantly in class from recent wins
runners_data.comment: No more than a fair turf comeback six weeks ago but the return here looks a plus
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f win at Newcastle and she was back on the scoresheet over that C&D 11 days ago; up from Class 5 today and her turf efforts leave her with something to find.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Angel, Zighy, and Hayynah will ensure a strong early gallop over this sprint trip at Chester's tight track. The three confirmed front-runners will clash from the start, with Ruby's Angel and Zighy likely to dispute the early lead while Hayynah tries to keep tabs. This sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final furlong. The strong gallop clearly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the pace-setters will be vulnerable to late challengers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong pace suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go hard early and create a genuine gallop
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Cherry Baker and Tarot benefit most from their patient tactics and proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Angel or Zighy gets an easy lead and controls fractions
scenarios.body: The winner dictates terms throughout and has enough left to resist late challenges. Their class tells when allowed to set their own pace without serious pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace moderate, tactical finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go steady and save energy for sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the two-furlong pole with all horses still in contention. Prominent racers with tactical speed like Slay Queen can position perfectly for late strikes.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy start disrupts favourites
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early or interference hampers key contenders
scenarios.body: An outsider benefits from the chaos and gets a clear run when others are struggling. Trust Amy or Fizzy Cristal could exploit the confusion with late surges.

watchPoints.text: Ruby's Angel and Zighy could go too fast early and set the race up for closers
Tarot returning after long break may need the run despite obvious ability
Cherry Baker's inside rail position could be crucial if she gets a clear passage
Slay Queen needs to bounce back quickly from poor Newmarket effort four weeks ago
Trust Amy's quick reappearance after Listed run may indicate she's thriving

races.name: General Elliot Croft Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Bemersyde
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong finishing kick, ideally suited to benefit from expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: Respectable C&D debut; keeping-on 3rd at Windsor (1m) last week; toughish task
runners_data.spotlight: Minor honours over 1m at Newmarket (good) and Windsor (good to firm) on first two starts, before a lesser show under 7lb claimer on latest outing; one to note stepped up to 1m2f for this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Gatehouse
runners_data.note: Proven at the trip with good AW form, hold-up style perfect for anticipated race shape
runners_data.comment: A 2nd and two wins on AW; return to 1m2f should suit and further improvement is possible
runners_data.spotlight: Bright start to career on AW included a novice win at Chelmsford (1m2f) in December and short-head handicap win at Southwell (1m) in April; however, he was put firmly in his place on turf debut at Newmarket (good to firm) four weeks ago when a return to 1m2f should have suited.

runners_data.name: Blue Noon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed greenness when in front last time, may prefer to follow pace
runners_data.comment: Fourth at Leicester (7f) on her debut and over this trip at Newmarket; may yet do better
runners_data.spotlight: Minor honours in maiden/novice events at Leicester (7f), Newmarket (1m2f) and Salisbury (1m3f); led over 2f out last time but looked green in front and carried her head a bit high; early days, going handicapping first time.

runners_data.name: Knowledge
runners_data.note: Limited experience but prominent style could work if positioned correctly behind pace battle
runners_data.comment: Narrow win in a 1m AW novice in January; tough task conceding weight all round today
runners_data.spotlight: Benefited from the runner-up hanging sharply left when narrow winner of 1m novice at Southwell (AW) in January on debut; outsider of five when he finished last in novice at Yarmouth (1m2f, good; bred to stay) seven weeks ago, behind talented rivals but it did not advertise his claims; gelded before this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Timber Twelve
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose early speed will help set up the race for others
runners_data.comment: 2-2 and brings plenty of potential to this turf/handicap debut; must be considered
runners_data.spotlight: Made most to win 1m novices on AW at Kempton in September and Southwell in March; that perfect start was followed by a lesser front-running effort at Epsom (8.5f, good) on turf/handicap debut but he looks bred for 1m2f.

runners_data.name: Mayaada
runners_data.note: Most experienced runner with good recent form, prominent style suits anticipated pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Fair effort at Epsom (8.5f) latest but the new, longer trip isn't sure to suit; vulnerable
runners_data.spotlight: After 12 races, for two wins, she should be far more exposed than today's rivals; however, her best form was on last two outings when second at Epsom (8.5f, good) and winning with a steady late bid at Salisbury (upped to 1m2f, good; 4lb higher today) and that earns respect.

runners_data.name: Advance Twentyfive
runners_data.note: Struggled this term but prominent style and course form give him each-way claims
runners_data.comment: Below form at Thirsk (behind Inishbeg) on reappearance and remains a maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a maiden here last September; best form in valuable sales races (also 7f) on next two outings but nowhere near repeating it in his two starts this term; hampered early in a York handicap last time (7f; 22-1) and this is a major rethink on his trip, but none too persuasive.

runners_data.name: Folk Pageant
runners_data.note: In-form front-runner with recent handicap win, likely to be involved in pace battle
runners_data.spotlight: Last of nine on handicap debut at Southwell (1m, AW; 11-1) in March but won starts either side in a maiden at Lingfield (1m, AW; made all) and eight-runner handicap at Newmarket (1m2f, good; always prominent); the latter was by a short head at 25-1 but she's gone up just 3lb since that rallying display and that does not look harsh.

runners_data.name: Crockham Heath
runners_data.note: Strong on AW when leading but turf form raises questions about effectiveness here
runners_data.comment: Well beaten here on debut; won twice on AW, with authority last time; could be useful
runners_data.spotlight: Front-running wins in a Southwell novice (1m) and Wolverhampton handicap (9.4f; with authority) in his only two AW races; those were way better than turf performances at Newmarket on debut and in 1m2f handicap (good to firm) on latest outing, which is a concern even though these are early days.

runners_data.name: Home Hero
runners_data.note: Returning after 268-day break, prominent style could work if fitness holds up
runners_data.spotlight: Finished closer each time in his three-race 2yo career and met trouble in running when fourth of nine at Haydock (1m, good) on final outing, looking on an even keel only very late in the day when running on well; gelded the following day; highly likely to stay and he's a fascinating handicap newcomer who needs a close look for any strength behind him in the betting.

runners_data.name: Carwyn
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer but recent form shows concerning fade pattern in finishes
runners_data.comment: Remote last of eight at Chester (1m4f, good; 80-1) on British debut 15 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Twice showed fair form at 1m in his four Irish races last term for Ger Lyons; well beaten on handicap debut there, however, and it was the same story this month on both British starts.

races.paceDynamic: Timber Twelve, Crockham Heath, and Folk Pageant will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three proven front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. The sustained pace over 1m2½f at Chester's tight turns will test stamina reserves, particularly as these pace-setters have shown they can maintain their efforts. With multiple confirmed leaders and prominent runners like Blue Noon, Knowledge, and Mayaada also likely to race handily, the pace will be genuine throughout. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina who can finish strongly off the searching gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a strong pace throughout the extended trip
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will set up perfectly for stamina-laden hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Horses with tactical speed and finishing kicks will benefit most from the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Timber Twelve and Crockham Heath engage in an early speed battle
scenarios.body: The two main pace-setters will soften each other up, allowing prominent racers with good stamina to strike in the final stages. Those positioned just behind the leaders will have the perfect stalking position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: A tactical front-running performance could see the leader dictate terms and prove too strong for the field. Folk Pageant's recent form suggests he could be the one to make all.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more sedate than expected despite multiple leaders
scenarios.body: A steadier gallop would bring more horses into contention and create a more open finish. This scenario would suit those with tactical pace who can quicken when required.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Timber Twelve gets an easy uncontested lead as his front-running style could prove hard to peg back
Monitor the early fractions between Crockham Heath and Folk Pageant as a fierce pace duel could set up the race for closers
Keep an eye on Bemersyde's positioning in the early stages as he needs the strong pace to set up his finishing kick
Watch Mayaada's jumping from the gates given her prominent style and need to secure good early position
Observe Home Hero's fitness levels given the 268-day layoff and whether he can sustain his effort over the extended trip
